Name: Luxurious Large Villa
Author: YellowSlime233
Description:
非常非常巨大的一个室内地图，根据中国上海的顶级豪宅檀宫-里维埃拉式进行制作。

一共具有三层+一个地下室，虽然是多层结构但全部在一张地图上，由树叶分隔成不同的区域。

可以通过每一层的楼梯或者电梯到达其他楼层。

其中电梯的菜单面板可以i18n化，需要其他语言请自行翻译。

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
一些特点：
1.独特的电梯功能，可以以跨楼层传送。
2.所有绿地都可以种植，水里可以钓鱼，一楼中间的绿地具有温室效果。
3.可以在这个地图中任何地方建造农场建筑。
4.地图具有四季变化（[s]但没有昼夜和天气，看起来像是pif不支持通过cp修改地图资源所以没做，也有可能是我自己没找到方法T T[/s]）

25.08.21
为地图添加昼夜和黄昏差分.
同时使用MMAP将背景转变为动态（由白天到黄昏再到夜晚的渐变）以及部分天气效果.

将整张地图转变为温室效果.

使用方法：
下载安装好前置，将本模组文件放入mod文件夹，然后找到任意一个pif门并会放置，点击pif门即可选择该地图。

[b][color=#ff7700]*注意*如果你使用了我的另一个模组"粉甜游乐园"就不要再使用这个模组，因为粉甜游乐园已经内置了这个地图，同时安装会出现地图重复以及一些未知的bug.
             MMAP并不是强制使用的,只是如果没有MMAP那么地图背景依然会保持为静态(但依然纯在差分只是不再会渐变和跟随视角移动)
[/color]             [color=#ff7700]如果使用了MMAP,请尽量将界面缩放保持在95%，不然背景会出现缺失.[/color]
[/b]

A very, very huge indoor map, made in the style of the top luxury mansion in Shanghai, China, the Tangong Riviera.

It has a total of three floors and one basement, although it is a multi story structure, it is all on one map, separated into different areas by leaves.

You can reach other floors through the stairs or elevators on each floor.

The menu panel of the elevator can be i18n, please translate it yourself if you need other languages.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Some characteristics:
1. Unique elevator function that allows for cross floor transmission.
2. All green spaces can be planted, fishing can be done in the water, and the green space in the middle of the first floor has a greenhouse effect.
3. Farm buildings can be built anywhere on this map.
4. The map has seasonal variations ([s]but without day, night, and weather, it looks like PIF does not support modifying map resources through CP, so it was not done. It is also possible that I did not find a way to myself T T[/s])

25.08.21
Add day night and dusk differences to the map

Simultaneously use MMAP to transform the background into dynamic (gradient from daytime to dusk and then to nighttime) and some weather effects

the entire map into a greenhouse effect

usage method:
Download and install the frontend, put the mod file into the mod folder, then find any pif door and place it. Click on the pif door to select the map.

[color=#ff7700][b]*Attention: If you have used my other mod "Pink Sweety Amusement Park", please do not use this mod again, as Pink Sweety Amusement Park already has this                         map built-in, and installing it may result in duplicate maps and some unknown bugs.
                       
                       MMAP is not mandatory to use, it's just that without MMAP, the map background will still remain static (but still purely differential, only not gradient                         and follow the viewpoint movement)

[/b][/color]                  [color=#ff7700][b] If using MMAP, please try to keep the interface zoom at 95%, otherwise the background will appear missing.[/b][/color]
